instructions_en.title: How to Complete This Menu Tracking Form
steps: This form documents one week of meals provided to an individual. Complete this form every three months to ensure proper nutritional care and meal variety.
Use the interactive meal planning grid below to record what was served each day.
Name: Enter the full name of the individual receiving meals.
Week Sampled: Enter the date range for the week being documented (e.g., "12/1/2025 - 12/7/2025").
Provider: Enter the name of the meal provider or caregiver.

instructions_en.title: For Each Day of the Week
steps: Document meals in all four categories:
Breakfast: What was served for the morning meal
Lunch: What was served for the midday meal
Dinner: What was served for the evening meal
Snacks: Any snacks provided throughout the day

instructions_en.title: Meal Documentation Requirements
steps: Write down specific foods and beverages served
Include main dishes, sides, and drinks
Be descriptive (e.g., "Scrambled eggs, wheat toast, orange juice" not just "Breakfast")
List multiple snacks if provided
Note any meal refusals or substitutions if relevant

instructions_en.title: Nutritional Guidelines
steps: Before submitting, verify:
⚠️ Important: Documentation must be submitted to Real Care, Inc. no later than the 3rd of the following month. Submit to: documentation@realcarecolorado.com or call 303-284-5818 with questions.
Meals are to be wholesome and nutritious
Individuals need to be provided with a choice of meals and snacks
Ensure variety throughout the week
Consider dietary restrictions and preferences
All 7 days are documented (Monday through Sunday)
All 4 meal categories are filled in for each day
Meal descriptions are specific and detailed
Variety is shown across the week
Nutritious options are included
Choices are evident in the meal plan
Review all meal entries for accuracy
Ensure the week sampled dates are correct

instructions_es.title: Cómo llenar este formulario
steps: Conteste cada pregunta.
Revise sus respuestas.
Firme y envíe.
